state_transitions.nonclaim: The receipt has no full source commit/tree, immutable run ID, exit/timeout state, executor digest, result digest, or DB snapshot/WAL coordinate; it is not exact-source release evidence.
Recovery does not erase the fail-open counterexample and does not prove that future incomplete runs cannot again render green.
No EXPORT_SERIALIZATION_RECEIPT/v1 or adversarial overlap repair receipt is present.
Observed concentration is not causal evidence that learned routing improves held-out task outcomes.

target_execution_boundary.nonclaim: Workflow failure labels with steps=[] are infrastructure/null results, not semantic failures and not execution receipts.

primary_source_refresh.title: SLSA v1.2 Build Provenance
primary_source_refresh.finding: Provenance binds subject digests, resolved dependencies, builder identity and run metadata; this supports full source/tree and execution binding instead of short source prefixes.

primary_source_refresh.title: JSON Schema null reference
primary_source_refresh.finding: JSON null is a distinct value and is not equivalent to absence or numeric zero; null test counts must not be promoted to a successful zero-failure result.

primary_source_refresh.title: SQLite Isolation
primary_source_refresh.finding: WAL readers observe a stable historical snapshot while newer commits may exist; cross-consumer metrics require an explicit shared snapshot/WAL coordinate.

hypotheses.claim: A single COMPLETE|INCOMPLETE|ERROR receipt, atomically binding full source/tree, test run, result digests, executor, DB snapshot/WAL coordinate, export run and commit admission, prevents null counts and stale snapshots from rendering a green acceptance state.
hypotheses.test: Inject timeout, killed process, null counts and overlapping exports A/B. Only COMPLETE B may update letzter-lauf, Verlauf and ZIELE; all other consumers must render UNMEASURED and archive or reject stale A.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any incomplete or older receipt can still yield fulfilled/green in one consumer, or a complete current run is rejected without a declared invariant violation.

hypotheses.claim: The current path concentration is substantially driven by repeated audit/export observation traffic rather than task-useful learned routing; therefore top-decile concentration alone overstates emergent retrieval utility.
hypotheses.test: Freeze one DB snapshot, label edge origins, exclude export/audit/instrumentation accesses, and run a preregistered shadow A/B on held-out real queries comparing no-learning, current routing and counterfactually shuffled ranks. Measure exact answer/task success, latency and privacy errors.
hypotheses.falsifier: The hierarchy remains stable after observer-traffic removal and current routing improves independently scored held-out outcomes over both controls without leakage.

hypotheses.claim: A metric should receive semantic credit only when raw measurement, declared threshold, verdict and every promoted consumer share one immutable receipt ID and rendering function.
hypotheses.test: Generate wegehierarchie.json, WEGEHIERARCHIE.md and ZIELE.md solely from one HIERARCHY_RECEIPT/v1, then mutate one consumer or threshold and require a fail-closed mismatch.
hypotheses.falsifier: Independent consumer implementations remain semantically identical under randomized boundary and error cases without a common receipt or rule digest.

counterhypotheses.counterevidence: Generation 171 produced a later Git child containing an older captured snapshot.
Two Generation 182 exports had null counts yet a downstream goal consumer rendered 584/0 fulfilled.

counterhypotheses.attack: The current top six tunnels are repeated C-AUDIT sibling edges, the top-decile share is 0.135 versus 0.099 baseline, the system's own raw verdict is GLEICHVERTEILT, and no held-out causal outcome is bound.

new_concepts.name: Null-Receipt Resurrection Hazard
new_concepts.definition: A failed or incomplete measurement is silently resurrected as an earlier successful aggregate when a consumer falls back across runs.

new_concepts.name: Snapshot Authority Lattice
new_concepts.definition: Temporal authority derived jointly from capture time, immutable run ID, DB/WAL coordinate, source tree and commit admission rather than Git child order alone.

new_concepts.name: Observer-Traffic Hierarchy Confounder
new_concepts.definition: Instrumentation, export or audit access that strengthens graph paths and can masquerade as task-driven learned structure.

new_concepts.name: Metric Consumer Quorum
new_concepts.definition: Agreement of raw measure, rule digest, verdict and all promoted renderers on one immutable receipt before semantic credit.
